title: Detergents Regulation (EU) 2026/405

productGroups.notes: Adopted 2026-02-11, published in the OJ 2026-03-02. Nothing determinable yet. retentionYears is sourced: the Regulation requires 10 years after placing on the market, including in cases of insolvency.

notes: Two things worth keeping straight. First, the passport date is marked assumed rather than sourced: 2029-09-23 comes from a secondary source and has not been read out of the primary text (CELEX 32026R0405), and until it has it must not be presented as a legal deadline. Second, detergents is a direct instrument, not an ESPR delegated act — it appears in the ESPR Art. 18 statutory priority list but was NOT selected into the 2025-2030 working plan, so no ESPR act is coming for it and this Regulation is the whole of its passport obligation. Consequential difference from every other instrument here: under this Regulation the passport replaces the EU declaration of conformity as the primary means of demonstrating compliance, so a defective passport costs an operator its conformity route rather than one disclosure among several.
